titulo_es: A simple instruction · Messages and warnings

texto: Read first who writes and for whom. In an instruction, the verb usually appears at the beginning: «Luk døren» (close the door). «Venligst» appears in formal requests; other short formulas are common in daily requests.
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
